environment: Windows; Node 24.19.0; Playwright 1.63.0 / Chromium 153.0.8010.12; ja-JP; Asia/Tokyo; Codex in-app browser; Poppler 120 dpi; Python 3.12.14 / Pillow 12.3.0 / pypdf 6.10.0
reviewer: NOEMA; AI UI/code/visual review on 2026-10-21; not a human usability study

default-page-quality.notes: Reviewed the current interface in IAB at 1280 x 720 and 320 x 800: page composition labels, white paper, left binding and hierarchical TOC. Four changed reference files were individually inspected for white paper and final label changes; expected/actual/diff paths and hashes are in baseline-review.json. The existing maxDiffPixels 0 contract is retained. The final complete operation/image gate is recorded separately in output/verification/product.json.

vertical-glyphs-and-spacing.notes: Current-revision PDFs were independently rendered with Poppler at 120 dpi. Inspected all main and excerpt pages in nine contact sheets plus native foundation, A5 exceptions, mixed-book body and new hierarchical TOC/body views. Ruby, emphasis, bold, rotated Latin, numbers, dashes, horizontal columns and left-bound page sequence show no observed unintended clipping, overlap or mirroring in these fixtures. This does not establish full JLREQ compliance.

mobile-usability.notes: Reviewed composition settings and TOC preview at 320 x 800. Notification captures at desktop and 320 px retain exactly the same workspace/editor/paper bounds before and after a validation message. Import success notices yield to resumed work. Real phones, software keyboards, Safari/Firefox, screen readers and human user evaluation remain untested.

export-appearance.notes: Reviewed all current-revision full-book and excerpt output cases with independent Poppler images, commands, exit codes and hashes in pdf-review/*/render.json. TOC indentation, final numbers, intentional blanks and original excerpt folios match the canonical pages. Separate pypdf completion checks verify bitmap identity, hierarchy, link targets/rectangles and reading direction. Raster RGB output only; searchable text/font embedding, PDF/X, CMYK and print-shop acceptance remain outside support.

local-first.notes: Reviewed changes to the canonical model, margins/binding, structured TOC, final-page navigation and local notifications. Existing local storage conflict/recovery and source-preservation flows stay in the completion gate. No production dependency or external manuscript service was added. GitHub publication contains application code, docs, artificial fixtures and reviewed reference images; it excludes runtime manuscripts/assets, storage values, output and release/tag creation.
